s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic breast abnormality with chronic inflammatory infiltrate
salient_findings: New 1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast on mammography
Mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils on histologic examination
No discrete abnormality on targeted breast ultrasonography
key_facts: 48-year-old woman with no breast symptoms
Routine screening mammography showed a new asymmetry
Asymmetry persisted on craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views
Targeted breast ultrasonography showed no discrete abnormality
Tomosynthesis-guided vacuum-assisted biopsy was performed
Histologic examination revealed marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate
Inflammatory infiltrate was enriched in eosinophils, with lymphocytes and plasma cells
No granulomata were present on histologic examination
Patient has a history of seasonal allergic rhinitis
Peripheral blood eosinophil levels were within the normal range

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic examination revealed marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils

shortlist.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic examination revealed marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic lobulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Inflammatory infiltrate was enriched in lymphocytes and plasma cells

shortlist.label: Periductal mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic examination revealed marked periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate

shortlist.label: Plasma cell mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Inflammatory infiltrate was enriched in plasma cells

raw.rationale: The histologic examination revealed a marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, which is consistent with eosinophilic mastitis.

rejected.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
rejected.why: Too broad, as the specific finding of eosinophil enrichment points towards a more specific diagnosis

rejected.label: Lymphocytic lobulitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific mention of lymphocytic predominance in the histologic findings

rejected.label: Periductal mastitis
rejected.why: While periductal involvement is noted, the specific eosinophilic enrichment is more characteristic of eosinophilic mastitis

rejected.label: Plasma cell mastitis
rejected.why: Although plasma cells are present, the key feature is the eosinophilic infiltration, not plasma cell predominance
